title: Citus: graceful Patroni switchover on a chosen group + RTO
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster citus --node citus-worker2`: a graceful patronictl switchover of the worker2 group to its streaming replica, measured to the new leader, then a switch-back. The VRRP VIP follows the new leader so pg_dist_node needs no rewrite (workers registered by VIP). --node selects a group (coord/worker1/worker2) or a node; default = the coordinator group.

observe.what: original primary citus-worker2/citus-worker2-1 -> new primary citus-worker2-2; RTO timeline (~1.6s live); recovery=recovered; VIP-follows-leader hint

observe.where: ssh a worker2 node: sudo nexus-patronictl list
observe.what: the promoted member is Leader; the old leader is a streaming Replica

whatProves: CitusAdapter.FailoverAsync runs a graceful patronictl switchover (needing the patroni.yml ctl: client cert) on the targeted Patroni group and measures the RTO to the new leader; the keepalived VIP follows so the Citus metadata is untouched.
